_comment: Marketing + marketplace site. No user auth — see gate.yml for the auth-smoke skip rationale.
_redirects: The four commercial URLs 307 to /services on purpose (3f21ea1, 2026-08-05 — the site offered four price points across four pages and a buyer could not tell what was for sale). next.config.js keeps them `permanent: false` deliberately, because `permanent: true` is cached hard by browsers and would make restoring /pricing or /engagement painful. So the smoke pins 307 exactly: a 2xx here would mean the redirect was removed, and a 308 would mean someone made it permanent, and both deserve to fail the gate rather than pass silently. /services is listed separately so the destination itself is walked — a redirect that lands on a 404 is not coverage.
